_readme: Fixtures for the word-pattern detector. Phase 1 of
Sanitized and synthetic. They are written in the shape of a real recorded
class (Indian English, Tamil words the transcriber renders phonetically,
classroom management, ASR errors) but contain no real student, and no real
class transcript is checked in here. The recording that these were modelled
on stays outside the repo because it has children's names in it.
A case with an empty `expect` is an assertion of SILENCE. Those are the
important ones: the detector's job is mostly to say nothing. Cards cost the
teacher attention in the middle of a lesson, so a false alarm is not a
neutral miss - it is an interruption.
`query` is matched loosely: a detection answers an expectation when either
